text:
maria: Customer reported they redeemed a free-trial promo via SSO yesterday, got a confirmation email, but their org balance shows 0. Promo code: FREE-SSO-2026. Org: acme-marketing (org_id: org_04b7f2). Customer claims UI shows 'Redeemed' and email receipt attached.

support-bot: Thanks for the report, @maria — creating escalation. Ticket #INC-10234. Please include any webhook or ledger traces. :white_check_mark:

alex: Hi all — I'm on billing. Can you paste the ledger apply webhook payload and the relevant delivery logs? Also the claim timestamp (approx) and the user id that did the SSO flow.

maria: Copying what the customer saw. Redeem time ~2026-03-15T18:23:10Z. User: sam@example.com (user_id: usr_9c3). Customer forwarded email with claim id: claim_7a1. UI shows redeemed flag for that user.

maria: Webhook delivery logs from our ingestion service (redacted):
```
POST /webhooks/promo HTTP/1.1
Host: webhook.redwood.test
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "claim_id": "claim_7a1",
  "org_id": "org_04b7f2",
  "user_id": "usr_9c3",
  "promo": "FREE-SSO-2026",
  "amount": 5000,
  "status": "acknowledged"
}
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{ "status": "ingested", "event_id": "evt_88f" }
```

alex: Webhook was ingested, thanks. Next step: check the downstream ledger apply job output. That usually shows a transaction id if applied.

jordan: I pulled the background job logs for apply_credits around that time. See snippet: 
```
2026-03-15T18:23:15Z apply_credits job started for evt_88f
2026-03-15T18:23:15Z resolving org mapping for usr_9c3 -> org_04b7f2
2026-03-15T18:23:16Z ERROR: identity-mapper returned multiple matches, choosing first (staging-org_02)
2026-03-15T18:23:16Z attempt to write ledger transaction failed: 500 InternalError -> db/ledger write timeout
```

jordan: Looks like the identity mapper returned multiple matches and the job picked a different org (staging-org_02) then the ledger write failed, so no transaction was committed. That explains 0 balance.

alex: Nice catch. Two issues: (1) identity mapping ambiguity for SSO users, (2) retry path failed to commit. For immediate customer relief I can apply a manual credit to org_04b7f2 and link it to claim_7a1. Will do if @maria confirms.

maria: Please do manual credit, customer is on a demo call in 30m. Also can we get an audit export for claim_7a1 and evt_88f?

sam: Confirming — received confirmation email, still showing 0 in billing UI. Appreciate quick fix.

alex: Manual ledger entry applied: tx_993c created, amount 5000, note: "manual apply for claim_7a1 (SSO mapping bug)". Updated balance for org_04b7f2 to 5000. Customer should see it immediately.

maria: Customer confirmed after a couple mins: balance now shows 5000. :tada: I'll message them and close the loop.

alex: I'll follow up with a reimbursement/reconciliation process to ensure staging-org_02 doesn't get any orphan credits. Also creating a bug: ID BUG-5601 for identity-mapper to tighten matching rules and fail-fast on multiple matches.

jordan: I'll patch the retry handler so failed writes back off and requeue rather than returning success. Also adding an alert for 'apply_credits write failures' to oncall.

maria: Great. Action items: alex -> manual apply + reconciliation (done), jordan -> patch retry & alert (in progress), eng-auth -> fix identity-mapper matching (assigned to eng-auth). Closing the customer-facing issue.

support-bot: INC-10234 updated to resolved by alex. Notes: manual credit tx_993c, root cause: SSO identity mapping ambiguity + ledger write failure.

sam: Thanks everyone for the fast help!
